name: Air Metal VA
old_description: Founded in 1970, Air Metal has been serving the Central Virginia region with high quality custom sheet metal & roofing work for over 50 years.
about:
Air Metal VA was founded in 1970 by Douglas and Gladys Smith in Richmond, Virginia. The company has served the Central Virginia region for over five decades with custom sheet metal fabrication and metal roofing. Since 2021, the business has continued the Smiths' legacy, operating as a family-owned shop with a team that brings more than 60 years of combined fabrication experience.

The company runs a full-service fabrication shop capable of handling projects of any size. Its core work includes standing seam roofing panels — snap lock, mechanical lock, and nail strip — as well as 5V crimp roofing, metal soffit and wall panels, fascia, valleys, coping, and drip edge. Air Metal also produces custom gutters, roofing soffits, chimney caps, cupolas, conductor heads, vents, and HVAC components such as ducting, fittings, plenums, diffuser boxes, and register boxes. Historic duplication of architectural metalwork is another specialty.

Air Metal serves residential and commercial construction customers across Central Virginia, supplying roofing contractors, HVAC installers, and general contractors who need custom sheet metal components. The shop's output ranges from standard roofing panels to one-off architectural pieces for historic restoration projects.

The company emphasizes its deep regional experience and the ability to match Virginia's unpredictable weather with durable, custom-fabricated metal solutions. Its differentiator is the combination of a fully equipped fabrication shop and a team with decades of hands-on expertise, allowing it to turn nearly any project vision into reality.
